description: Query autocomplete suggestions from search engines for keyword research

query.help: Get autocomplete suggestions for a query.

arguments.name: query
arguments.help: Search query to get suggestions for

options.name: --source
options.help: [google|youtube|bing|amazon|ddg]  Sources to query (google, youtube, bing, amazon, ddg). Can be repeated

options.name: --depth
options.help: Recursion depth (how many levels deep to query)

options.name: --recurse-limit
options.help: Max suggestions to recurse into per level (default: 5)

query.usage_instructions: Get keyword suggestions from search engine autocomplete. QUERY is required (positional). Use --source/-s to select engines (google, youtube, bing, amazon, ddg -- can repeat for multiple). Use --filter/-f to only show suggestions containing specific text. Use --recurse/-r with --depth/-d to recursively expand suggestions (default depth: 1, limit: 5 per level). Use --limit/-l (default: 100), --table/-t.

sources.usage_instructions: Show which search engines are available as autocomplete sources. Use --table/-t for formatted output.

suggest.usage_instructions: Keyword suggestion tools -- query autocomplete APIs and list available sources.

auth.usage_instructions: Authentication and profile management for the Keywords CLI. Use `auth status` or `auth test` to verify the shared auth contract, and use `auth profiles` when you need to inspect or switch saved profile state.

login.help: Configure authentication credentials. Prompts for required credentials based on the tool's authentication type. For OAuth authorization code flows, opens a browser for user consent.
login.usage_instructions: Initialize or refresh the shared auth profile state for Keywords. Use `--profile/-p` to target a specific profile and `--force/-F` to clear ephemeral state before re-authenticating.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to save credentials to

logout.usage_instructions: Clear stored auth state for a profile. Use `--profile/-p` when you need to remove a non-default profile's saved state.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to clear credentials from

status.help: Check authentication status across profiles. Performs a live round-trip for every configured credential type so the report reflects ground truth — not on-disk belief. Saved credentials whose live verification fails are reported as ``authenticated: false`` with the failure reason in ``api_test``.
status.usage_instructions: Check auth status across profiles using the shared live-verification flow. Use `--table/-t` for readable output or `--profile/-p` to inspect one profile.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to check (defaults to all profiles)

test.help: Test authentication by verifying credentials work across profiles.
test.usage_instructions: Run the shared auth verification explicitly. Use `--verbose/-v` for per-check detail and `--profile/-p` to scope the test to one profile.

profiles.usage_instructions: Inspect and manage named auth profiles for Keywords. Use this group to list, inspect, create, delete, or set the default profile backing the shared auth contract.

list.help: List all profiles and show which is the default.

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of profiles to return

options.name: --properties
options.help: Comma-separated list of fields to include

get.help: Get details for a specific profile.

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Profile name to get details for

create.help: Create a new profile from .env.example template.

set-default.help: Set a profile as the default (IS_DEFAULT_PROFILE=1).

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Profile name to set as default

delete.help: Delete a profile and its data.

clear.help: Remove all cached responses. Deletes every file in the cache directory ({storage_dir}/cache/) and reports how many files and bytes were freed.
clear.usage_instructions: Run `keywords cache clear --help` for exact arguments and options.

cache.usage_instructions: Run `keywords cache --help` for exact arguments and options.

usage_instructions: Use for keyword research by querying autocomplete suggestions from multiple search engines (Google, YouTube, Bing, Amazon, DuckDuckGo). Supports recursive expansion of suggestions. Commands follow `keywords suggest <action>` pattern.
